document.heading: Authorizing the Leasing of Administrative Facilities with the United States of America
document.text: A Resolution authorizing the negotiation and execution of a lease agreement with the United States of America pursuant to Section 105(l) of Public Law 93-638; designating a tribal official as the appropriate official to provide information regarding said lease on behalf of the Upper Mattaponi Tribe.
document.preamble: At a duly called General Meeting of the Upper Mattaponi Tribal Council held this 26th day of September, 2026, the following Resolution and Law were adopted.

recital.text: the Upper Mattaponi Tribal Council ("Council"), pursuant to the Constitution of the Upper Mattaponi Tribe, possesses legislative authority to establish policy and priorities on behalf of the Tribe; and

federal law requires the Secretary of the U.S. Department of the Interior to enter into a lease agreement with a tribe proposing a lease pursuant to Section 105(l) of Public Law 93-638, as amended (codified at 25 U.S.C. § 5324(l)), with such lease compensation as calculated in accordance with 25 C.F.R. Part 900 Subpart H (beginning at 25 C.F.R. § 900.69); and

the U.S. Department of the Interior requires tribes and tribal organizations to certify that all information provided by the tribe or tribal organization for purposes of calculation of calculating lease compensation under Section 105(l) of Public Law 93-638 is true and correct.

that the Chief of the Upper Mattaponi Tribe, or their designee, is authorized to submit a lease proposal to the U.S. Department of the Interior for the following facilities pursuant to Public Law 93-638:

ul.li: UMT Government Complex (Tribal Grounds) – 13476 King William Rd., King William, VA 23086
Sharon Indian School – 13383 King William Rd., King William, VA 23086
Community Services Office – 353 Kelley Ln., King William, VA 23086
Program Management Office – 17 Kelley Ln., King William, VA 23086
Natural Resources Office (Rolands Place) – 13324 King William Rd., King William, VA 23086
Sharon Rd Offices – 1041 Sharon Rd., Ste. 201 & 202, King William, VA 23086

recital.text: that the Chief of the Upper Mattaponi Tribe, or their designee, is authorized to negotiate and execute said lease agreement on behalf of the Upper Mattaponi Tribe and to take all measures necessary to implement said lease agreement for Fiscal Year 2026 and subsequent lease periods for which funds are available; and

that the Chief of the Upper Mattaponi Tribe, or their designee, is hereby designated as the appropriate official to verify the information provided by the tribe or tribal organization for purposes of calculating lease compensation under Section 105(l) of Public Law 93-638 and is hereby authorized to attest as to the accuracy of such.

procedural-data.text: The foregoing Resolution was duly voted upon by the Council on the 26th day of September, 2026, at a General Meeting with a vote of 6 in favor and 0 opposed, 0 abstaining, and 1 absent, pursuant to the authority vested in the Council by the Constitution of the Upper Mattaponi Tribe.
